tool.name: GWASLab Harmonization
tool.description: Align GWAS summary statistics to reference resources and update harmonization status
tool.command: python '$__tool_directory__/run_harmonization.py' --input '$input' --input-format '$input_format' #if str($build) != "unset" --build '$build' #end if --reference-mode '$reference_selector.reference_mode' #if str($reference_selector.reference_mode) == "direct" #if $reference_selector.ref_seq --ref-seq '$reference_selector.ref_seq' #end if #if $reference_selector.ref_infer --ref-infer '$reference_selector.ref_infer' #end if #if $reference_selector.ref_rsid_tsv --ref-rsid-tsv '$reference_selector.ref_rsid_tsv' #end if #if $reference_selector.ref_rsid_vcf --ref-rsid-vcf '$reference_selector.ref_rsid_vcf' #end if #else --reference-bundle '$reference_selector.reference_bundle' --reference-manifest '$reference_selector.reference_manifest' #end if --ref-alt-freq '$ref_alt_freq' --ref-maf-threshold '$ref_maf_threshold' --maf-threshold '$maf_threshold' --threads '$threads' #if $remove --remove #end if --output-tsv '$output_tsv' --output-meta '$output_meta' --log '$log'

param.name: reference_mode
param.label: Reference input mode
param.option: Use direct reference files uploaded in Galaxy
Use a reference bundle and manifest

param.name: ref_alt_freq
param.label: VCF INFO field used for reference allele frequency

param.name: ref_maf_threshold
param.label: Reference MAF threshold for strand inference

param.name: maf_threshold
param.label: Summary-statistics MAF threshold for strand inference

tool.help:
This tool wraps GWASLab harmonization and makes the reference inputs explicit for Galaxy use.
Input summary:
- one GWAS summary-statistics table, ideally after load/standardize/QC - either direct reference files or a previously prepared reference bundle plus manifest
Reference roles:
- `ref_seq`: FASTA used for allele checking against the reference genome - `ref_infer`: VCF used for strand inference and allele-frequency-aware harmonization - `ref_rsid_tsv`: lightweight rsID lookup table - `ref_rsid_vcf`: broader rsID lookup VCF
Output summary:
- `harmonized table`: the updated summary-statistics table after GWASLab harmonization - `metadata`: JSON summary of row counts, reference mode, and which reference roles were used - `log`: the GWASLab harmonization log
Galaxy usage plan:
- direct mode: upload or select FASTA/VCF/TSV references from history - bundle mode: select the `reference bundle` and `manifest` produced by the reference-download tool - in bundle mode, the runner extracts the archive, resolves files by manifest role, and passes the real paths to GWASLab
Testing locally:
```bash planemo test tools/harmonization/tool.xml ```
